_comment: Verification harness for PR #6152 (chart env name typo). Consumed by scripts/re-verify.sh. The defect is in the Helm chart, so the discriminating layer is 'render', not 'unit'.

findings.claim: The chart must emit the recover warning threshold under RECOVER_WARNING_THRESHOLD, the only name pkg/csi/recover/recover.go reads. Pre-fix it emitted REVOCER_WARNING_THRESHOLD, so csi.recoverWarningThreshold was silently discarded.
Every env var the chart sets on the csi-plugin container must be read somewhere in the tree. Regression guard for chart/Go env-name drift — this is the check that was missing and let the typo ship.

Impact half of F1: with only the misspelled name exported, threshold resolution falls back to defaultRecoverWarningThreshold=50 and the operator's value is lost. Green on both refs by design (Go was never wrong) — it documents impact, it does not discriminate the fix.

The chart toolchain renders a misspelled env name with no error or warning, so neither `helm template` nor the weaker `helm lint` sweep in .github/workflows/project-check.yml could have caught this. SKIPs on the pre-fix ref (nothing to un-fix) — there the same fact is shown by the pre-fix render succeeding at all.

envNotes.helm: Requires the `helm` binary on PATH; the render layer skips without it. Rendering is made hermetic inside the test (chart copied to a temp dir, templates calling helm `lookup` dropped, KUBECONFIG=/dev/null) because charts/fluid/fluid/templates/webhook/plugins-profile.yaml otherwise contacts a live API server and makes the result depend on the reviewer's kubeconfig.
envNotes.darwinPreExisting: On darwin, 3 pre-existing specs in the ginkgo suite TestRecover fail with 'util/mount on this platform is not supported'. Verified identical on the merge-base without this harness, so it is unrelated to PR #6152 and to the harness. The scoped -run filter in layers.unit.cmd avoids them; CI's linux unittest job is green.

liveNote: No live (L3) layer: the fix is a rendered manifest field, fully provable at the render layer. To confirm end-to-end anyway, install the chart with --set csi.recoverWarningThreshold=<n != 50> and check `kubectl -n fluid-system get ds csi-nodeplugin -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[?(@.name=="plugins")].env}'` contains RECOVER_WARNING_THRESHOLD=<n>, then confirm the csi-nodeplugin log warns 'excessive mount count detected ... threshold=<n>' rather than threshold=50.
